units: <cite ref="Berakhot 56a:2">Ber. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>מפשר ליה לג׳</he> he interpreted his dream unfavourably, opp. <he>למעליותא</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 99b:18-19">B. Kam. 99ᵇ</cite> <he>עביד בך … תרתי לג׳</he> he has doubly injured thee (through his verdict).
